jobs.title: AI Engineer (Algorithms)
jobs.description:
About Arondite

Arondite builds software that lets teams coordinate autonomous systems, data and AI across many platforms, so the people in charge can make critical calls sooner and with more confidence.
jobs.requirementsSection:
We want a team with many kinds of background and outlook, so nobody is expected to cover every point below. Apply even if you match only part of the lists.

You should have:
jobs.benefitsSection:
• Strong base salary
  • Meaningful EMI share options in a funded, growing company
  • 7% employer pension contribution
  • Lunch provided in the office
  • Private health and dental cover, dependents optional
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Help with relocation
